_note: Demo cases shown on the Y-finder welcome screen. People are fictional; questions, places, data and Yale access routes are real. scripts/record_demos.py runs each script against the live agent and saves the event stream to static/demos/<id>.json so the app can replay it quickly and reliably, then continue live. Cases with group "yale" are grounded in real YCGS projects and Yale programs (program and program_url name the source); their people are fictional too.
